title: cert-manager
description: Installs upstream cert-manager (operator and CRDs). Issuers and Certificates live in the cert-manager-issuers blueprint, which depends on this one.

global.title: Global values
global.description: Helm global values (injected when this chart is used as a subchart).

cert-manager.title: Upstream chart values
cert-manager.description: Passthrough to the upstream cert-manager chart. Helm requires subchart values to live under a key named after the subchart and cannot compute them at render time, so a curated surface at this chart's top level would be silently ignored.
